name: Ildathach

attributes.attribute: a name for the Otherworld when seen as a floating island, meaning many-colored land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ildathach is an Irish mythological site. The Otherworld was sometimes pictured as a floating island. It then bore this name. The name means many-colored land. It refers to the gorgeous and unearthly colors of the island.
objective: Document Ildathach as a name for the floating-island Otherworld.
key_results: Record Ildathach as a name for the Otherworld.
Explain the meaning of the name as many-colored land.
